221  @Override
222  public void registerPluginChannels() {
223
224    // Redis handlers are registered in registerStorage() after TNPC's legacy
225    // proxy-channel registration phase has finished. Cross-server sync no
226    // longer registers or relies on Bukkit plugin messaging channels.
227  }
228
229  @Override
230  public void registerStorage() {
231
232    final boolean syncEnabled = syncEnabled();
233    final String syncType = syncEnabled? resolveSyncType() : "Redis";
234    final TNECoreSupport.StorageRegistration registration = TNECoreSupport.prepareStorage(syncEnabled, syncType);
235    final StorageSettings settings = registration.settings();
236    JedisPool pool = registration.pool();
237
238    if(pool != null && !redisAuthRuntimePresent()) {
239      PluginCore.log().error("Redis auth runtime classes are missing from this build. Cross-server sync will be disabled for this startup.",
240                             DebugLevel.OFF);
241      pool.close();
242      pool = null;
243      this.syncEnabledAtStartup = false;
244    }
245
246    if(pool != null && !redisConnectionAvailable(pool)) {
247      pool.close();
248      pool = null;
249      this.syncEnabledAtStartup = false;
250    }
251
252    this.storage = new StorageManager(DataConfig.yaml().getString("Data.Database.Type"),
253                                      new TNEStorageProvider(), settings, pool);
254  }
255
256  private boolean redisAuthRuntimePresent() {
257
258    for(final ClassLoader loader : candidateClassLoaders()) {
259      if(classPresent("redis.clients.authentication.core.Token", loader)
260         || classPresent("net.tnemc.libs.jedis.authentication.core.Token", loader)
261         || resourcePresent("redis/clients/authentication/core/Token.class", loader)
262         || resourcePresent("net/tnemc/libs/jedis/authentication/core/Token.class", loader)) {
263        return true;
264      }
265    }
266    return false;
267  }
268
269  private boolean redisConnectionAvailable(final JedisPool pool) {
270
271    try(final Jedis jedis = pool.getResource()) {
272      jedis.ping();
273      return true;
274    } catch(final Exception e) {
275      PluginCore.log().error("Unable to connect to Redis (" + e.getMessage()
276                             + "). Cross-server sync will be disabled for this startup.",
277                             DebugLevel.OFF);
278      return false;
279    }
280  }
281
282  private List<ClassLoader> candidateClassLoaders() {
283
284    final List<ClassLoader> loaders = new ArrayList<>();
285
286    addLoader(loaders, Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader());
287    addLoader(loaders, this.getClass().getClassLoader());
288    addLoader(loaders, TNECore.class.getClassLoader());
289    addLoader(loaders, PluginCore.class.getClassLoader());
290
291    return loaders;
292  }
293
294  private void addLoader(final List<ClassLoader> loaders, final ClassLoader loader) {
295
296    if(loader != null && !loaders.contains(loader)) {
297      loaders.add(loader);
298    }
299  }
300
301  private boolean classPresent(final String className, final ClassLoader loader) {
302
303    try {
304      if(loader == null) {
305        Class.forName(className);
306      } else {
307        Class.forName(className, false, loader);
308      }
309      return true;
310    } catch(final Throwable ignored) {
311      return false;
312    }
313  }
314
315  private boolean resourcePresent(final String resource, final ClassLoader loader) {
316
317    try {
318      if(loader == null) {
319        return ClassLoader.getSystemResource(resource) != null;
320      }
321      return loader.getResource(resource) != null;
322    } catch(final Throwable ignored) {
323      return false;
324    }
325  }
326
327  private String resolveSyncType() {
328
329    final String configured = DataConfig.yaml().getString("Data.Sync.Type", "Redis");
330    if(configured != null && (configured.equalsIgnoreCase("redis")
331                               || configured.equalsIgnoreCase("jedis"))) {
332      return "Redis";
333    }
334
335    PluginCore.log().error("Data.Sync.Type \"" + configured + "\" is no longer supported. Falling back to Redis.", DebugLevel.OFF);
336    DataConfig.yaml().set("Data.Sync.Type", "Redis");
337
338    try {
339      DataConfig.yaml().save();
340    } catch(final IOException e) {
341      PluginCore.log().error("Unable to persist Data.Sync.Type migration to Redis.", e, DebugLevel.STANDARD);
342    }
343
344    return "Redis";
345  }

347  @Override
348  public @NotNull <A extends CommandActor> LampBuilderVisitor<A> registerParameters() {
349
350    return builder->builder.parameterTypes()
351            .addParameterType(Account.class, new AccountResolver())
352            .addParameterType(AccountStatus.class, new StatusResolver())
353            .addParameterType(DebugLevel.class, new DebugResolver())
354            .addParameterType(Currency.class, new CurrencyResolver())
355            .addParameterType(BigDecimal.class, new BigDecimalResolver())
356            .addParameterType(ParseMoney.class, new MoneyResolver())
357            .addParameterType(PercentBigDecimal.class, new PercentDecimalResolver());
358  }

367  @Override
368  public void registerCallbacks(final CallbackManager callbackManager) {
369
370    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.ACCOUNT_TYPES.id(), new CallbackEntry(AccountTypesCallback.class));
371    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.ACCOUNT_LOAD.id(), new CallbackEntry(AccountLoadCallback.class));

373    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.ACCOUNT_CREATE.id(), new CallbackEntry(AccountCreateCallback.class));
374    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.ACCOUNT_DELETE.id(), new CallbackEntry(AccountDeleteCallback.class));
375    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.TRANSACTION_PRE.id(), new CallbackEntry(PreTransactionCallback.class));
376    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.TRANSACTION_POST.id(), new CallbackEntry(PostTransactionCallback.class));

379    callbackManager.addCallback(TNECallbacks.DENOMINATION_LOAD.id(), new CallbackEntry(DenominationLoadCallback.class));

382  @Override
383  public String commandHelpWriter(final ExecutableCommand command, final CommandActor actor) {
384
385    final MessageData data = new MessageData("Messages.Commands.Help.Entry");
386    data.addReplacement("$command", command.path());
387    data.addReplacement("$arguments", MessageHandler.getInstance().getTranslator().translateNode(new MessageData("Messages.Commands." + command.usage()), "default"));
388    data.addReplacement("$description", MessageHandler.getInstance().getTranslator().translateNode(new MessageData("Messages.Commands." + command.description()), "default"));
389
390    return MessageHandler.getInstance().getTranslator().translateNode(data, "default");
391  }

393  @Override
394  public void registerUpdateChecker() {
395
396    if(MainConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Core.Update.Check")) {
397      PluginCore.log().inform("Running version: " + version() + " Build: " + build());
398      PluginCore.log().inform("Build Stability: " + Updater.stability(version(), build()));
399
400      PluginCore.server().scheduler().createDelayedTask(()->{
401        this.updateChecker = new Updater();
402
403        if(this.updateChecker.needsUpdate()) {
404          PluginCore.log().inform("Update Available! Latest: " + this.updateChecker.getBuild());
405        }
406
407        if(this.updateChecker.isEarlyBuild()) {
408          PluginCore.log().inform("Running pre-release version! Thanks for being a tester!");
409        }
410      }, new ChoreTime(0), ChoreExecution.SECONDARY);
411    }
412  }

414  @Override
415  public void postConfigs() {
416
417    this.syncEnabledAtStartup = DataConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Data.Sync.Enabled", false);
418    if(this.syncEnabledAtStartup && !ChannelSecurity.configured()) {
419      PluginCore.log().error("Data.Sync.Security.Token is not configured. Redis will not be initialized until a non-default token is set.",
420                             DebugLevel.OFF);
421      this.syncEnabledAtStartup = false;
422    }
423
424    PluginCore.log().inform("Cross-server synchronization is "
425                            + ((this.syncEnabledAtStartup)? "enabled; Redis will be initialized."
426                               : "disabled; Redis will not be initialized."));
427
428    if(!this.economyManager.currency().load(PluginCore.directory(), false)) {
429      return;
430    }
431
432    this.economyManager.currency().saveCurrenciesUUID(PluginCore.directory());
433
434    final UUID serverID;
435    //Set our server UUID. This is used for proxy messaging.
436    final boolean randomUUID = MainConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Core.Server.RandomUUID", false);
437
438    if(!randomUUID) {
439      if(!MainConfig.yaml().contains("Core.ServerID")) {
440
441        serverID = UUID.randomUUID();
442        MainConfig.yaml().set("Core.ServerID", serverID.toString());
443        MISCUtils.setComment(MainConfig.yaml(), "Core.ServerID", "Don't modify unless you know what you're doing.");
444
445        try {
446          MainConfig.yaml().save();
447        } catch(final IOException e) {
448          PluginCore.log().error("Issue while saving Server UUID to config.yml", e, DebugLevel.OFF);
449        }
450      } else {
451        serverID = UUID.fromString(MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.ServerID"));
452      }
453    } else {
454      serverID = UUID.randomUUID();
455    }
456    PluginCore.instance().setServerID(serverID);
457
458  }

465  @Override
466  public void postEnable() {
467
468    MenuManager.instance().addMenu(new MyEcoMenu());
469    MenuManager.instance().addMenu(new MyBalMenu());
470    MenuManager.instance().addMenu(new TransactionMenu());
471
472    PluginCore.log().debug("Loading All Accounts....");
473
474    this.storage.loadAll(Account.class, "");
475
476    PluginCore.log().debug("Loading All Receipts....");
477
478    this.storage.loadAll(Receipt.class, "");
479
480    this.economyManager.setReloadTime(new Date().getTime());
481
482    PluginCore.log().debug("Checking Server account...");
483
484    final String name = MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Account.Name");
485    serverAccount = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(("NonPlayer:" + name).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
486
487    if(MainConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Core.Server.Account.Enabled")) {
488
489      if(economyManager.account().findAccount(serverAccount.toString()).isEmpty()) {
490
491        PluginCore.log().inform("Creating Server Account.");
492
493        final AccountAPIResponse response = economyManager.account().createAccount(serverAccount.toString(), name, true);
494        if(response.getResponse().success()) {
495
496          PluginCore.log().inform("Server Account has been created.");
497
498          final BigDecimal defaultBalance = new BigDecimal(MainConfig.yaml().getString("Core.Server.Account.Balance"));
499          if(defaultBalance.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) > 0) {
500            response.getAccount().ifPresent(value->value.setHoldings(new HoldingsEntry(economyManager.region().defaultRegion(),
501                                                                                       economyManager.currency().defaultCurrency().getUid(),
502                                                                                       defaultBalance,
503                                                                                       EconomyManager.NORMAL
504            )));
505          }
506        } else {
507          PluginCore.log().error("Unable to create Server Account. Reason: " + response.getResponse().response());
508        }
509      }
510    }
511
512    PluginCore.log().debug("Checking if AutoSaver hamsters are ready....");
513    //Set up the auto saver if enabled.
514    if(DataConfig.yaml().getBoolean("Data.AutoSaver.Enabled")) {
515
516      this.autoSaver = PluginCore.server().scheduler().createRepeatingTask(()->{
517                                                                              PluginCore.log().inform("Running AutoSaver.");
518                                                                              storage.storeAll();
519                                                                           }, new ChoreTime(0),
520                                                                           new ChoreTime(DataConfig.yaml().getInt("Data.AutoSaver.Interval"), TimeUnit.SECONDS),
521                                                                           ChoreExecution.SECONDARY);
522    }
523
524    PluginCore.log().debug("Checking for forgotten balances....");
525
526    economyManager.printInvalid();
527
528    PluginCore.log().debug("Firing up BalTop Caching System....");
529    PluginCore.server().scheduler().createDelayedTask(()->economyManager.getTopManager().load(), new ChoreTime(2), ChoreExecution.SECONDARY);
530    PluginCore.server().scheduler().createRepeatingTask(()->economyManager.getTopManager().load(), new ChoreTime(2), new ChoreTime(MainConfig.yaml().getInt("Core.Commands.Top.Refresh"), TimeUnit.SECONDS), ChoreExecution.SECONDARY);
531  }
532
533  @Override
534  public void postDisable() {
535
536    if(autoSaver != null) {
537      autoSaver.cancel();
538    }
539
540    if(storage == null) {
541      return;
542    }
543
544    final Optional<Datable<?>> accountData = Optional.ofNullable(storage.getEngine().datables().get(Account.class));
545    accountData.ifPresent(datable->datable.storeAll(storage.getConnector(), null));
546
547    final Optional<Datable<?>> receiptData = Optional.ofNullable(storage.getEngine().datables().get(Receipt.class));
548    receiptData.ifPresent(datable->datable.storeAll(storage.getConnector(), null));
549  }
